component.name: MultiFlexi Database Connection
component.summary: PDO database connection credential prototype for MultiFlexi

description.p: Provides the database connection credential prototype for MultiFlexi core, defining the PDO driver, host, port, database, user and password configuration fields required to connect to a MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQLite database.
Also ships a web UI component with an interactive DSN builder wizard, a live PDO connection test, server version and driver information display, and database table listing.
